trigger.label: When a pull request is attached

confirmation.title: Enable this Rule?
confirmation.body: Enabling this Rule starts paid vendor model requests owned by this Island. Campus sends the Rule instructions, exact pull request identifiers, and only the verified bounded pull request diff to the configured Anthropic, OpenAI, or xAI model provider. In a review team, the aggregator also receives the child review results. The sandbox cannot read the repository checkout or operator files. The provider processes and may retain this content under the operator's provider account terms. A single review starts one logical reviewer; a team starts one per reviewer plus one aggregator. Each reviewer can make multiple metered provider requests. All Rules share the Island's active-reviewer and 12-request hourly limits. A non-visitor Agent may initiate at most six admissions per rolling hour, reserve or settle at most $6 of provider cost per rolling hour, and keep one exact-target review active at a time; all team children count against that initiating Agent. Work refused by a limit is recorded as failed and requires a new exact-head review after capacity clears. Campus runs every call in a bounded, read-only review environment. Codex subscription reviews reserve the full supported model output maximum because the subscription service does not accept a smaller output cap. This can exhaust review capacity even when the eventual answer is short. Current limits prevent Agent-initiated Codex subscription reviews even after shared capacity clears. Human-initiated reviews remain subject to Island limits.

confirmation.title: Archive this Rule?
confirmation.body: Archiving disables this Rule and keeps its revisions and run history.
